FirstLook Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 3, 2026

FirstLook is a Chrome extension that helps users monitor user-selected Facebook Marketplace searches and category feeds.

Information FirstLook processes

FirstLook may process Marketplace listing information visible in the user’s browser, saved deal-feed settings, extension preferences, license information, and Telegram connection information needed to deliver optional mobile alerts.

How information is used

Information is used only to provide the extension’s core features, including license validation, saved deal feeds, fresh-listing detection, and optional mobile alerts.

Storage

Deal-feed settings and extension preferences may be stored locally in Chrome extension storage. License and Telegram connection information may be processed through FirstLook’s backend services.

Sharing

FirstLook does not sell personal information. Information may be shared with service providers only as necessary to operate licensing and mobile-alert functionality.

Third-party services

FirstLook interacts with Facebook Marketplace and may use Telegram for optional mobile alerts. Those services are governed by their own privacy policies.
